subject: Geopolitics
title: Treaties That Drew the Map
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Treaties That Drew the Map.

hook.text: The Treaty of Tordesillas in 1494 split the entire world between Spain and Portugal with a single line.

buildup.text: Major treaties reshape borders after wars. Versailles, Westphalia, and Vienna each redrew continents.

discovery.text: Treaty borders reflect power, not justice. Winners carve; losers accept. The map shows who won.

twist.text: Many treaty borders planted future wars. Versailles humiliated Germany so deeply that it fueled Hitler's rise.

climax.text: Today's frozen conflicts — Kashmir, Cyprus, Korea — are all unfinished treaty business from decades past.

punchline.text: Every border is a story of who lost the last war.

quiz.question: What did the Treaty of Tordesillas do in 1494?
options: Split the world between Spain and Portugal
Created the border between France and Germany
